title: Great Magnets
text: Great Magnets. These are great magnets! They are pretty durable and should hold up for a long time. They come in a metal tin. I am planning to put these in my daughter's Christmas stocking.

product_metadata.title: Lantern Press Protect Our National Parks Magnets Set of 12, Series 3 – Central & East
features: Includes: Acadia, Everglades, Shenandoah, Gateway Arch, Mammoth Cave, Biscayne, Great Basin, Badlands, Black Canyon of the Gunnison, Wind Cave, Cuyahoga Valley
Packaged in a reusable hinged metal tin
Each Magnet: 1 ⅞" x 1 ½" x ⅛"
Metal Tin: 3 ¾" x 2 ⅞" x ¾"
description: Collect Lantern Press illustrations of all the National Parks. This magnet set will remind you of your favorite places every day. Our Protect Our National Parks Collection honors our 63 National Parks, places of solace and wonder that have never been more resonant! By partnering with 1% for the planet, Lantern Press proudly donates 1% of sales from this collection to National Parks. Lantern Press is a dynamic art company that specializes in the world's leading imagery. Our collection includes original works created by our in-house art team, photography, home & office decor trends, vintage art, and more. Your support allows us to continue doing what we love - creating beautiful art.
